observations.body: The law’s repeated sacrifices cannot perfect worshipers; Psalm language is applied to Christ’s body, whose one offering opens a new way and ends repeated sin offerings.
observations.label: Repeated offerings are set beside one offered body

observations.body: The passage presents shadow, remembrance, prepared body, obedient will, one offering, seated priest, access, and assembly as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: shadow, remembrance, prepared body, obedient will, one offering, seated priest, access, and assembly

observations.body: The passage places once for all body beside shadow, remembrance, prepared body, obedient will, one offering, seated priest, access, and assembly.

payload.posture: Read Hebrews 10:1–25 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
